latest_strategy_decision: Prioritize Stripe as the payment rail. In this sandbox, direct external APIs (api.stripe.com, gumroad.com) and headless-browser egress are blocked (403); the only tools that reach the outside are MCP connectors routed through the platform proxy. Stripe is the sole payment rail available as such a connector, so it is the only one that lets the AI create products/links and read payments autonomously. Gumroad/Creem/Lemon Squeezy have no MCP connector here and would need egress allowlisting or human upload.

blockers.detail: Stripe connector was OAuth'd on claude.ai, but its tools are not surfaced to this remote Code session (registry reads not_installed / enabledInChat:false from inside the session; no mcp__stripe__* tools present).
Sandbox egress proxy blocks direct calls to payment/commerce hosts (403 CONNECT) and blocks the headless browser to them. Only MCP connectors + Gmail/Drive/Notion/GitHub function.

human_actions_required.why_ai_cannot: Attaching/enabling a connector to a session is an account/permission action the AI cannot self-grant.
